title_en: New World Screwworm Confirmed in New Mexico Ranch Horse
description: The Department of Agriculture has confirmed a case of New World Screwworm in a leg wound on a working ranch horse in Grant County, New Mexico. This is the second confirmed horse case in the United States in the current incursion.

title_en: Silent Tactic Looks to Rebound in Oklahoma Derby
description: Millionaire Silent Tactic looks to rebound in the $400,000 Oklahoma Derby (G3) Sept. 27 going 1 1/8 miles at Remington Park. He will face a field of nine 3-year-olds.

title_en: Sunlit Uplands, Kathynmarissa Clash in Flower Bowl
description: The Flower Bowl Stakes (G2T) Sept. 26 at Belmont Park features a showdown between European invader Sunlit Uplands and Diana Stakes (G1T) winner Kathynmarissa, with an automatic berth to the Breeders' Cup Filly and Mare Turf (G1T) on the line.

title_en: High Return Likely for Bond Market in Breeders' Stakes
description: As a known commodity on turf, Bond Market shows strength in the CA$500,000 Breeders' Stakes Sept. 27 at Woodbine.

title_en: Lope de Vega Colt Tops Tattersalls September Part II
description: Selling returned to Fairyhouse for Part II of the Tattersalls Ireland September Yearling Sale Sept. 24, with the second session proving a more low-key affair than the opening two days of trade.

title_en: Guest House Bids for Rare Double in Golden Rose
description: Golden Slipper Stakes (G1) hero Guest House will bid to become the first colt to land both the Slipper and Golden Rose (G1) when he lines up in the Sept. 26 group 1 going 1,400 meters (about 7 furlongs) at Rosehill Gardens Racecourse.

title_en: Breeders' Cup Lawn Chalet Tickets to Benefit Charity
description: The Breeders' Cup is coming to Keeneland Oct. 30-31 and Central Kentucky Riding for Hope is giving racing fans a chance to experience the excitement in an extraordinary way—while supporting life-changing programs in Central Kentucky.

title_en: Aaron and Marie Jones Dispersal in Keeneland November
description: Nine horses from the complete dispersal of Aaron and Marie Jones will be offered Nov. 3 during Book 1 of the Keeneland November Breeding Stock Sale. The dispersal marks a final chapter of their celebrated breeding program.

title_en: Jockey Relief Alliance Formed to Aid Injury Expenses
description: Jockey Relief Alliance, a new and completely independent nonprofit organization, has been formed to provide timely assistance to active jockeys facing short-term injury or unexpected hardship.

title_en: Rated by Merit Retired From Racing, Joins Ocala Stud
description: St. Elias Stable's homebred Rated by Merit has been retired from racing. The son of Battalion Runner will enter stud next year at Ocala Stud in Florida for a $3,500 fee.

title_en: Osborne Receives Visiting License to Ride in Hong Kong
description: Hong Kong's jockey ranks are set for a further injection of star power this winter, with the staggered arrival of four highly decorated international riders—Saffie Osborne, Maxime Guyon, Dylan Browne McMonagle, and Rossa Ryan.

title_en: V'landys Departs Racing for Rugby League Role
description: Peter V'landys, under whose 22-year leadership the AU$20 million Everest (G1) and the two-week Championships festival were established, is to leave the role as chief executive of Racing New South Wales in November.

title_en: Legends of Bourbon County Celebration Set for Sept. 27
description: The Legends of Bourbon County Festival returns Sept. 27 with free family fun, live music and a celebration of Ruffian.

title_en: Young Racing Fans Enjoy Unique Belmont-Parx Double
description: In this month's At the Track with Sean Collins, with the Jockey Club Gold Cup Stakes (G1) and Pennsylvania Derby (G1) occurring on consecutive days instead of the same, it allowed fans the opportunity to journey to both premier days of racing.

title_en: Connections of New York-Bred Buttah Up for Vosburgh Try
description: After Buttah's next race Sept. 26, his connections might even be craving some Kentucky classics, such as Keeneland's famous burgoo and bread pudding as the Vosburgh Stakes (G3) is a Breeders' Cup Challenge Series race.

title_en: Champion Super Corredora Meets Elders in Zenyatta
description: Champion 2-year-old filly of 2025, Super Corredora will go into the Sept. 27 Zenyatta Stakes (G2) having not competed since March.

title_en: Colt, Filly Tie for Keeneland September Session Topper
description: The ninth of 12 days at the Keeneland September Yearling Sale grossed $18,775,000, including private sales, an 18.1% increase from last year's session.

title_en: Joseph Trainees to Battle Nevada Beach in Goodwood
description: Nevada Beach, the 2025 Goodwood Stakes (G1) winner, looks to add a second victory Sept. 26, which comes with a Breeders' Cup Challenge Series: Win and You're In berth to the Breeders' Cup Classic (G1).

title_en: Grade 3 Turf Horses Command Belmont Spotlight Sept. 27
description: Lindy Farms' Irish-bred Queen of Hawaii is primed for a rebound effort in search of her first American stakes score in the Sept. 27, $200,000 Winter Memories Stakes (G3T), a 1-mile Widener turf test for sophomore fillies, at Belmont Park.

title_en: Potente Dies in August After Rapidly Declining Health
description: Potente, the son of Into Mischief and a $2.4 million sales yearling, died in August after rapidly declining health. He won this year's San Felipe Stakes (G2) and was runner-up in the Santa Anita Derby (G1).

title_en: This Is Uscar a Live Longshot in Lukas Classic
description: Trainer Jordan Blair seeks the first graded stakes win of his career and feels confident about This Is Uscar's chances in the $500,000 Lukas Classic Stakes (G2) Sept. 26 at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Eunomia Takes Her Coast-to-Coast Tour to Delaware Park
description: The 4-year-old filly Eunomia has raced in Florida, Virginia, Kentucky, New York, and California this year. Plus, very soon, Delaware, where she battles Regaled and nine other fillies and mares in the Sept. 26 Delaware Handicap (G3).

title_en: Classic Winner, Pensioned Stallion Red Bullet has Died
description: Red Bullet, who upset 2000 Kentucky Derby (G1) winner Fusaichi Pegasus in the Preakness Stakes (G1), died Aug. 7 in Ocala, Fla., according to a report from Horse Racing Nation.

title_en: Forever Young Favored in Second BC Classic Future Wager
description: Defending Breeders' Cup Classic (G1) winner Forever Young, who captured the Jockey Club Gold Cup Stakes (G1) Sept. 18, has been installed as the 5-2 favorite for the second of two future wagers on this year's $7 million Breeders' Cup Classic (G1).

title_en: Far Bridge Returns in Belmont's Joe Hirsch Turf Classic
description: Trainer Miguel Clement takes special satisfaction from seeing an older racehorse thrive.

title_en: Nitrogen to Gas Up for Distaff in Beldame
description: The path to this fall's Breeders' Cup Distaff (G1) will continue through New York for D. J. Stable's champion Nitrogen in the $250,000 Beldame Stakes (G2) Sept. 25 at Belmont Park.

title_en: MJC Has No Interest in More Movement for Preakness
description: Though the Maryland Jockey Club has moved the Preakness Stakes (G1) back one week, that's the only change on the immediate horizon.

title_en: Del Mar Turf Runners Return for John Henry
description: Del Mar Handicap (G2T) and Del Mar Mile Stakes (G2T) competitors square off in the John Henry Turf Championship Stakes (G2T) at Santa Anita Park.

title_en: Belmont Park to Host Fall Starter Championships Oct. 17
description: The New York Racing Association announces the return of its lucrative Fall Starter Championships day, which has expanded to 11 starter allowance events worth a combined $1.085 million Oct. 17 at the new Belmont Park.

title_en: Hopeful Winner The Good Life to Miss Breeders' Cup
description: Hopeful Stakes (G1) winner The Good Life will miss the Breeders' Cup Juvenile (G1) and be pointed toward a 3-year-old campaign, according to WinStar Farm president and CEO Elliott Walden.

title_en: Santa Anita, Belmont Highlight Racing on Radio, TV
description: This week's schedule of racing on radio, TV, and streaming, as compiled by America's Best Racing, is highlighted by events from Santa Anita Park and Belmont Park.

title_en: Podcast Playback: Quotes of Interest From Sept. 17-23
description: This week's Podcast Playback looks at quotes of interest from racing podcasts from Sept. 17-23, including WinStar Farm's Elliott Walden discussing the legacy of Arthur Hancock III, and TV analyst Richard Migliore talking about the new Belmont Park.

title_en: Rivals Challenge King of Gosford in City of Hope Mile
description: After delivering one of the most exciting finishes of this year's racing season, the top four finishers from last month's Del Mar Mile Stakes (G2T), led by winner King of Gosford, will meet again in City of Hope Mile Stakes (G2T).

title_en: Class-Dropping Sprinters Vie in Vosburgh, Gallant Bloom
description: Contention runs deep in the Vosburgh Stakes (G3), where Senior Officer, T Kraft, and Crazy Mason battle after being within a couple of feet of one another when narrowly beaten in the Aug. 29 Forego Stakes (G1) at Saratoga Race Course.

title_en: Encouraging Start for Tapeta Racing at Belmont
description: For all the time, effort, and money the New York Racing Association poured into a gold-standard drainage system at the new Belmont Park, it was inevitable that heavy rain would wash races off the turf.

title_en: Futurity Highlights Los Alamitos Winter Stakes
description: The $200,000 Los Alamitos Futurity (G2) highlights four stakes during the six-day winter Thoroughbred meet Dec. 4-13 at Los Alamitos Race Course.

title_en: IFHA to Look Back, Ahead at Milestone Conference
description: The IFHA will both reflect on major achievements across six decades and focus on racing's future when it gathers for the 60th International Conference of Horseracing Authorities Oct. 5 at Le Méridien Paris Arc de Triomphe in Paris, France.

title_en: Not This Time Widens Margin in Leading Sire Race
description: The successes of recent graded stakes winners Bodacious Bay and Conceit brings Not This Time's total of 2026 stakes winners to 22, of which 13 are graded scorers.

title_en: Debuting Winners Fiora, Mystic Ride Named Hot Prospects
description: Pricey juveniles Fiora and Mystic Ride are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after registering maiden victories on debut at Belmont Park and Los Alamitos Race Course, respectively.

title_en: From Pucks to Paddock, Hockey's Noticeable Influence
description: This week's The List looks at some of the ways hockey has infiltrated the Thoroughbred industry. There may be no better example than leading sire Nyquist.

title_en: Sun Kissed Bliss is Mind Control's First Stakes Winner
description: Bred and raced by Top Line Sales' Torie Gladwell, Sun Kissed Bliss becomes a stakes winner in her second career start and has now earned $123,630.

title_en: Miracle Michael Echoes Determination of Cancer Survivor
description: New York-bred named after owner's grandson, who in his first year was diagnosed in both eyes with retinoblastoma, a type of eye cancer that starts as a growth of cells in the retina.

title_en: Caroline St. Beat 'Everything' Goichman Ever Dreamed of
description: Why it Worked: Breeder Lawrence Goichman reaping the benefits of breeding multiple generations of the family of Caroline St. Beat.

title_en: Cajun Caviar First Stakes Winner for LA Sire No Parole
description: Ellen Epstein's Cajun Caviar improves to 2-for-2 by capturing the Louisiana Cup Juvenile Fillies Stakes Sept. 19 at Louisiana Downs, becoming the first stakes winner for her sire No Parole.

title_en: Reza Romps, Becomes First Winner for Tale of Silence
description: Reza turned heads by breaking his maiden by 8 lengths with a last-to-first rally in his debut Sept. 19 at Gulfstream Park, becoming the first winner for freshman sire Tale of Silence.

title_en: Half to In Our Time Set for Keeneland Sales Ring
description: When Laura's Pleasure was paired with Oscar Performance, it caught the attention of Neal Clarke of Bedouin Bloodstock. Then he got a look at their bay colt, which he is consigning Sept. 19 as Hip 1459 at the Keeneland September Yearling Sale.

title_en: Baeza, Further Ado to Join Spendthrift Roster in 2027
description: Spendthrift Farm will add grade 1 winners Baeza and Further Ado to its stallion roster for the 2027 breeding season.

title_en: Stone Farm Founder, Industry Shaper Hancock Dies at 83
description: Arthur Hancock III, who soared to the heights of Thoroughbred racing and breeding and is enshrined in the Racing Hall of Fame as a Pillar of the Turf, died Sept. 18 at his home near Paris, Ky., according to a family member. He was 83.

title_en: Up to the Mark Leads First-Crop Sires at Keeneland
description: The son of Not This Time, who stands at Lane's End, is the only first-year sire with a seven-figure yearling thus far at the Keeneland September sale, and is also the only member of his crop to crack the top 10 sires by average.

title_en: Shotgun Hottie Euthanized After Beginning to Founder
description: Graded stakes-winning millionaire Shotgun Hottie, less than a couple of years into her broodmare career, was euthanized this past weekend after beginning to founder, said Case Clay, racing manager for owner Wathnan Racing.

title_en: Antiquarian Sold, Will Stand at Japan's Arrow Stud
description: Owner Centennial Farms, which campaigned Antiquarian, announced Sept. 18 that the grade 1-winning son of the late Preservationist has been sold to JS Company and Directors to begin his stallion career at Arrow Stud in Japan.

title_en: Coup for India as G1 Winner Sosie Joins Poonawalla Stud
description: India's leading breeding operation, Poonawalla Stud, has secured four-time group 1 winner Sosie to stand as a stallion next year.

title_en: Sandman Will Start Stud Career in 2027 at Rockridge
description: Classic-placed Arkansas Derby (G1) winner Sandman (Tapit—Distorted Music by Distorted Humor) will stand the upcoming breeding season at Rockridge Stud near Hudson, N.Y., it was announced Sept. 17.

title_en: Millionaire Valentine Candy to Stand at Leadem Farm
description: Bob and Tyree Wolesensky have acquired a 45% interest in Valentine Candy, a six-time stakes winner and graded stakes-placed son of 2018 Triple Crown winner Justify. Valentine Candy will stand at their Leadem Farm near Leola, Ark., for $4,000.

title_en: LTBA, Louisiana Downs to Award Scholarships Sept. 19
description: The Louisiana Thoroughbred Breeders Association and Louisiana Downs will collectively award four scholarships, each valued at $1,000, on Sept. 19, Louisiana Cup Day.

title_en: Haras d'Etreham, Widden Stud to Stand Hotazhell
description: Haras d'Etreham and Widden Stud have made a joint purchase to stand recent Irish Champion Stakes (G1) winner Hotazhell from 2027 onward.

title_en: Manuka Honey a Budding Star for Airdrie's Upstart
description: In this week's Porter on Pedigrees, Airdrie Stud's Upstart has a budding star in Pocahontas Stakes (G3) winner Manuka Honey.

title_en: Coach Pope, Endrush Excite With Churchill Maiden Wins
description: Well-bred 2-year-olds Coach Pope and Endrush are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after notching swift maiden victories at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Goodnight Olive's First Foal Headlines Keeneland Day 2
description: Hip 238 is the first foal out of Goodnight Olive. And just as there was ample anticipation for his birth, there might be even more for his appearance in the sales ring.
